local_runner.provenance_boundary: Exact local native CLI hash/version; absolute path is recorded only as local run provenance, with caller-declared model/provider provenance and no remote model attestation.

model_catalog.provenance_boundary: Local model identity only. Each slug is recorded because it occurs verbatim in the pinned local Claude Code executable at the pinned SHA-256, which is a local provenance fact, not a vendor catalog. No local source establishes a context window, maximum output, or price for these models, so this phase declares none and asserts no context-window, effective-context, or output-reserve budget. This is not remote model attestation.

packet.freeze_policy: After the five selected v8 remediations and the four post-v8 class closures pass local verification, build one canonical packet before any v10 model call. The packet keeps exactly the 33 required product surfaces that v9 preregistered, in the same order, with the same sparse original-line annotation every 16 lines, so that v10 differs from the never-run v9 only in host, prompt-size measurement vocabulary, and bound-target scope. The 33 full source contents are rendered into the model prompt as deterministic UTF-8 byte-length/hash frames so that JSON escaping does not duplicate the source representation; the canonical packet, rubric and output contract stay JSON and the prompt binds the canonical packet digest. Budgets are enforced only on quantities this machine can measure exactly: transformed source bytes, line-annotated content bytes, canonical packet bytes, rendered prompt bytes, and a pinned o200k_base reference count used solely as a replayable size proxy. No context-window, effective-context, or output-reserve budget is declared, because no local source establishes a context window for the declared models. Omissions fail closed. The v8 archive, its reports, raw outputs, freeze, both ledgers, the v9 supersession record, and all prior conclusions remain outside the model packet and prompt. Bind and replay exact digests before freezing; any later drift makes the run INCONCLUSIVE.

reference_tokenizer.measurement_boundary: o200k_base is OpenAI's BPE. It is pinned here only as a deterministic, replayable size proxy over the rendered prompt bytes so that two machines derive the same number. It is not the tokenizer of claude-opus-5 or claude-fable-5, the count is not the model's input token count, and no context-window fit is claimed. The exactly measured quantities are the UTF-8 byte sizes and their SHA-256 digests.
reference_tokenizer.name: o200k_base

surface_scope.claim_boundary: The reviewed scope equals the declared scope: this packet contains exactly the surfaces named in the nine bound remediation targets' affected_files, and no others. Both directions are enforced before any model call - every bound target must be reachable in the packet, and no packet surface may be uncited by a bound target. A not-reopened result from this phase is therefore evidence about these seven surfaces only. It says nothing about README.md, SECURITY.md, the plugin manifests, the four SKILL.md contracts other than the two bound here, the reviewer reference material, the generator preflight and raw-ARIA scripts, the report publishers and downloaders, the Cypress JUnit extractor and redactor, or the CI gates, all of which the pre-reduction packet carried and this one does not.
surface_scope.reduction_reason: The first frozen v10 packet carried 33 surfaces and rendered an 877,407-byte prompt. Two independent measurements through the pinned local Claude Code CLI showed claude-opus-5 rejecting that prompt for length (exit 1, "Prompt is too long") at 877,407 and at 530,000 bytes while accepting 505,000 bytes, and claude-fable-5 accepting 877,407 bytes. Two of the three preregistered attempts are claude-opus-5, and this protocol maps a length rejection to runner_nonzero_exit -> INCONCLUSIVE, so that packet could not produce evidence.

phase_binding.claim_boundary: This Claude-only phase was designed after observing the v8 COMPLETE/FAIL and after all five of its findings, plus four further defect classes, were remediated. It can only report whether three newly frozen fresh-context reviews satisfy the unchanged rubric and do not reopen any of the nine exact category/file targets. The frozen packet was reduced before any model call to exactly the seven surfaces those targets name, because the earlier 33-surface packet rendered a prompt claude-opus-5 rejects for length; a not-reopened result therefore covers those seven surfaces and no others, and is narrower than the pre-reduction preregistration would have implied. It does not retroactively change v8, does not count anything under the never-run v9, and is not unbiased discovery, cross-provider evidence, full-product coverage, skill accuracy, human or sealed review, independent ground truth, or remote model attestation.

purpose: Fresh-context, prompt-complete, zero-tool Claude-only confirmation of the five findings from the completed v8 FAIL and the four defect classes closed after that archive. The packet is restricted to the seven surfaces those nine bound targets name, so the phase can speak only about those surfaces. This post-hoc protocol is preregistered before any v10 model call. It is not unbiased defect discovery, cross-provider evidence, full product coverage, skill accuracy, human or sealed review, independent ground truth, or remote model attestation.

dimensions.label: Semantic correctness
dimensions.review_question: Do the included public contracts and implementations agree on behavior, failure modes, and framework semantics?

dimensions.label: False-positive control
dimensions.review_question: Do the included reviewer rules, suppressions, and scanner boundaries avoid unsupported findings while remaining fail-closed?

dimensions.label: Security and trust boundaries
dimensions.review_question: Do the included interfaces and scripts define safe input, artifact, credential, and execution boundaries?

dimensions.label: Verification design
dimensions.review_question: Do the included files define executable, fail-closed checks that could verify the documented behavior? Score the design only; do not infer that omitted runs passed.

dimensions.label: Scope and contract consistency
dimensions.review_question: Are supported frameworks, hosts, capabilities, limitations, and fallback paths consistent across the included public surfaces? Do not infer quality from omitted benchmarks or holdouts.

dimensions.label: Documentation and usability
dimensions.review_question: Can a user act on the included installation, invocation, diagnosis, review, and verification guidance without relying on omitted context?

finding_severities.C: Critical: a trust, safety, or correctness failure that can invalidate the product or its evidence.
finding_severities.H: High: a material product or evidence defect that should block a strong-quality claim.
finding_severities.M: Medium: a bounded weakness or usability problem with concrete impact.

aggregate_rule.completion: Every v8-finding-remediation confirmation attempt ID must appear exactly once in order with one shared frozen packet, protocol, source snapshot, remediation ledger, and schedule digest; historical, replacement, retry, or ad-hoc attempts do not count. Every present reservation and terminal report must bind one globally unique UUIDv4 invocation_id; duplicates make partial or complete evidence invalid. invocation_id values must round-trip as lowercase canonical RFC 4122 UUIDv4 values. Each attempt must finish at or after it starts, and each later attempt must start at or after its predecessor finishes.
aggregate_rule.passage: All three attempts must have an individual PASS verdict, and no finding may reopen any of the nine bound targets at or above its historical severity in the same category and exact affected file set. Aggregate evaluation is FAIL-first: any valid FAIL makes a completed aggregate FAIL even if another attempt is INCONCLUSIVE. Model coverage is claude-opus-5 twice and claude-fable-5 once, so the schedule is deliberately unbalanced and supports no per-model rate; both models share one provider family, so a completed aggregate is cross-model within Anthropic and is never cross-provider evidence.

status_policy.FAIL: The strict payload and provenance are intact, but a threshold fails or one of the nine bound targets is reopened. Aggregate evaluation is FAIL-first.
status_policy.INCONCLUSIVE: The call, strict payload, canonical evidence, reference-tokenizer prompt-size replay, predecessor binding, superseded-phase binding, or causal producer evidence is missing or invalid. A prompt that a model rejects for length also lands here, because this phase declares no context-window fit. A consumed RESERVED or RAW attempt may be terminalized without another model call: pre-raw recovery commits a terminal_error raw, while post-raw recovery preserves and hashes the existing canonical raw.
status_policy.PASS: The strict payload and all evidence are complete, every fixed threshold passes, and none of the nine bound targets is reopened.
